prompt: Why must you call super.paintComponent(g) at the start of a custom paintComponent()?
choices: To clear the panel and allow Swing to perform background painting before your custom drawing
To set the coordinate origin to (0,0)
To initialise the graphics context's color to black
explanation: super.paintComponent(g) clears the background (fills with the background color) and lets Swing handle opaque/transparent background logic. Skipping it causes artifacts — previous frames accumulate on screen.
